pages.text: Optics from the workshop make the Reflecting Telescope a better instrument. Each sits in it as a catalyst and is never used up.

A $(item)Schmidt Corrector Plate$() turns it into a survey camera: four plates at once give two Star Field Plates and a Deep Sky Plate (magnitude 15). An $(item)Echelle Grating$() spreads each star's light so finely that one exposure gives three Stellar Spectrum Plates. An $(item)Apochromatic Objective$() brings every colour to one focus: two Planetary Plates at a time.
